preconditions: known-good baseline captured, hashed and CRC-verified (baselines/device/<serial>/)
device link present and awake (harness state DEVICE_AWAKE)
virtual ARMOR-X + frida/btsnoop capture path available for observation

experiments.name: baseline-read-and-identity
experiments.expected: 0B reply carries the MCU/ZKM version; EF reply bytes 3..10 are the devUuid; D6 reply is a 144-byte config whose declared length == 144 and whose CRC-16/MODBUS over bytes 2..end matches the stored big-endian value at 0..1
experiments.proves: link state + protocol family + baseline integrity

experiments.name: e2-firmware-read
experiments.expected: reply payload matches or refines the 2A26 firmware string
experiments.proves: that E2 is the firmware read introduced in 4.0.8 and closes the 0xFC/0xF6 version-guard ambiguity

experiments.name: unknown-keyid-source-confirmation
experiments.variable: exactly one byte: mapKeys[<id>] (config byte 112+<id>) set to 2 (empty); CRC recomputed
experiments.expected: the physical button mapped to that source stops producing its action; all other buttons unchanged
experiments.proves: the id is a real remappable source (and for id 15, that it is Capture)
experiments.restore: rewrite the saved baseline image byte-for-byte, then re-read D6 and compare sha256
experiments.notes: id 15 first: this is the highest-value single experiment in the whole plan

experiments.name: dpi-selector-space
experiments.expected: reply/readback changes consistently with the selector; 0x11 is either masked to 0x01 or rejected
experiments.proves: the 4-bit selector mask and the readback shape
experiments.restore: set the selector back to the originally read value
experiments.notes: the DPI *values* behind the selectors are app/server side - read them from the UI, not the device

experiments.name: motion-dpi-echo
experiments.expected: readback equals the written value, proving width and endianness
experiments.restore: write back the value read at the start

experiments.name: lighting-framing-observation
experiments.variable: one zone colour changed through the app UI (no invented semantics)
requests: capture the frames the app emits (A5 04 70 commit, A4 ... 70 data)
experiments.expected: commit frame observed after one or more A4 data frames; LED sets travel as bitmasks
experiments.proves: the apply/commit split and the LED bitmask usage
experiments.restore: restore the previous lighting via the app
experiments.evidence_on_success: PROVEN LIVE for framing only; RGB/effect semantics stay UNKNOWN

experiments.name: d8-fragment-length-byte
experiments.variable: D8 fragment framing form (with vs without an ordinal byte) using the all-zero 10-byte disable payload
requests: D8 write of an all-zero 10-byte frame, both framing forms, one at a time
experiments.expected: the accepted form produces the write-result notification; the rejected form is ignored or errors
experiments.proves: the D8 length-byte rule and the fragment chunk size for this device id
experiments.restore: the macro slot was already empty (disable payload); re-enable from the app if needed
experiments.risk: medium - gated on L01 baseline and on the virtual capture path working
experiments.gate: do not run before L01 has produced a verified baseline

experiments.name: d8-repeat-time-unit
requests: write a 2-step macro on M1 with repeat enabled at t and at 2t
experiments.gate: only after L07 has established the D8 framing
